overloads.semanticRole: The SAX SET XML DECLARATION command initializes the XML document referenced in document using the specified encoding .

constraints: Must be called exactly once per document, before the first XML SET command in the document, otherwise an error is generated.
encoding defaults to UTF-8 if this command is never called, or falls back to UTF-8 if an unsupported character set is passed.
standalone defaults to False (document is not standalone) if omitted or if the command is not called.
indentation is obsolete and should not be used; document indentation is instead configured via the XML SET OPTIONS command.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): SAX write document lifecycle: SAX SET XML DECLARATION initializes document-level encoding/standalone settings once, before any other SAX write command -> SAX OPEN XML ELEMENT (or the ARRAYS variant) opens an element -> SAX ADD XML ELEMENT VALUE adds its content while it remains open -> SAX CLOSE XML ELEMENT closes the most recently opened element.
